beats.vo: Four to six servings. Multiply the ingredients, not the minutes.
Amounts do scale. One and a half pounds of chicken becomes two and a quarter pounds.

beats.on_screen: More chicken needs batches, not time
beats.vo: Broiling fifty percent more chicken does not mean fifty percent longer. Use two batches, eight to ten minutes each.

beats.on_screen: Start checking at 10 min. Watch the trail
beats.vo: A wider pan can reduce faster. Start checking at ten minutes. Stop by the spoon trail.
For coconut cream, go gentle. Whisk it smooth if separated. Keep a gentle simmer.

beats.on_screen: Real result. Oct 21 2026. Local app UI
beats.vo: Real RecipeFix result, captured October twenty first. Local build of the live UI. It changed amounts and affected steps.
Scale the food. Do not scale the clock. Use batches for space, and cues for doneness.

accepted.caption: Scaling up is usually a space problem, not a timer problem. Give food room, and use visible cues like a spoon trail.
